title: 第1章 激活幸福古城（求追读～）
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
【欢迎城主绑定‘幸福古城’，您的城池已激活，现向您发放新手大礼包】

    【我是您的古城小助手，您有需要可随时呼叫我】

    花期浑身湿漉漉地躺在青石板上，头发凌乱地贴在脸上，听着耳旁的电子音，对突然出现在古城的自己还恍恍惚惚。

    “什么是‘幸福古城’，你是谁？”

    【城主，我是古城NPC，您可以直接称呼我为小助，关于古城的介绍已传输进你的大脑】

    刹那间，一段文字飞入花期脑海。

    幸福古城，顾名思义就是需要建设的古城。

    和华夏的经营类游戏很相似，她接手一座古城，变成城主重新建设古城。

    花期视线落在终端的虚拟古城地图上。

    两百亩占地面积，有前后两扇城门，许许多多的店铺分布在古城街道上，名为种植区和花圃区的地方被一条河流分开。

    店铺和河流都是灰色的，只有河流边上的城主府和一家医馆被点亮。

    面板右上角是声望值，也是建设古城和解锁店铺最需要的东西。

    声望值后面是金额，上面显示着0。

    左边则是“招聘员工”选项，现在也被点亮，显示“每日招聘长期员工数量*1”并备注不限任何世界。

    “小助，我的工作只有建设古城吗？”

    【是的城主，人类移居蓝白星一千年，文化早已断代，曾经的华夏盛况已消失在历史的河流中。你的目标只有传播华夏文化，让星际所有生灵知道华夏的底蕴】

    花期迅速看完这些介绍，忍不住蜷了下手指。

    她曾是蓝星人。

    在二十二年前从蓝星穿到星际，变成一个被恶意调换只有几个月大的真千金。

    被父母找回后不受家里人喜爱，处处被假千金陷害，最终在大学毕业这一年被父母赶出家门并断绝关系。

    她想试试死亡能不能回蓝星，一时上头想不开跑去跳河。

    在濒死之际，就被系统传送到这里。

    花期在地上躺了一会儿，驱散了还想跳河的想法，望着周围熟悉的古城，眼里闪过一丝坚定。

    唐代万国来朝，大明威名远扬...

    没有哪个华夏人能在穿越后容忍文化丢失。

    以前花期没有能力，现在有了就更不能错过这个机会。

    更何况周边还有几个国家屡屡挑衅花国，天天在网上叫嚣如今的花国是小偷，到处偷窃别人国家的历史。
content_en:
[Welcome the city owner to bind to the ‘Happy Ancient City’, your city has been activated, and a newbie gift package will be issued to you]

    [I am your little assistant in the ancient city, you can call me anytime if you need it]

    Huaqi lay wet on the bluestone floor, her hair messy on her face, listening to the electronic sound in her ears, still in a daze about her sudden appearance in the ancient city.

    "What is the 'Ancient City of Happiness' and who are you?"

    [City Lord, I am the NPC of the ancient city. You can call me Xiaosuke directly. The introduction about the ancient city has been transferred to your brain]

    In an instant, a piece of text flew into Hua Qi's mind.

    Happy Ancient City, as the name suggests, is an ancient city that needs to be built.

    It is very similar to Chinese management games. She takes over an ancient city and becomes the city owner to rebuild the ancient city.

    Hua Qi's eyes fell on the terminal's virtual ancient city map.

    Covering an area of ​​two hundred acres, there are two city gates at the front and back. Many shops are distributed on the streets of the ancient city. The areas called planting area and flower garden area are separated by a river.

    The shops and the river were both gray, with only the city lord's palace and a medical clinic on the riverside lit up.

    The upper right corner of the panel is the reputation value, which is also the most needed thing for building the ancient city and unlocking shops.

    The reputation value is followed by the amount, which shows 0.

    On the left is the "Recruiting Employees" option, which is now also lit, showing "Daily Recruitment of Long-term Employees*1" with a note that it is not limited to any world.

    "Xiaosuke, is my job only to build the ancient city?"

    [Yes City Lord, it has been a thousand years since human beings migrated to Blue and White Star, and their culture has long since disappeared. The once prosperous China has disappeared in the river of history. Your goal is only to spread Chinese culture and let all living beings in the interstellar know the heritage of China]

    Huaqi quickly read these introductions and couldn't help but curl her fingers.

    She was once a Blue Star person.

    Twenty-two years ago, he traveled from Blue Star to the interstellar world and became a real daughter who was only a few months old and was maliciously exchanged.

    After being retrieved by her parents, she was not loved by her family and was framed by the fake daughter. Finally, she was kicked out of the house by her parents and severed ties with her the year after she graduated from college.

    She wanted to see if death could help her return to Blue Star, but she couldn't think of anything else and ran to jump into the river.

    When he was about to die, he was teleported here by the system.

    Huaqi lay on the ground for a while, dispelling the thought of jumping into the river, looking at the familiar ancient city around her, a trace of determination flashed in her eyes.

    During the Tang Dynasty, all nations came to visit, and the Ming Dynasty became famous...

    No Chinese can tolerate the loss of culture after time travel.

    I didn’t have the ability during the flowering period before, but now that I have it, I can’t miss this opportunity.

    What's more, there are several neighboring countries that have repeatedly provoked the Flower Country. They clamor online every day that the Flower Country is a thief and steals the history of other countries everywhere.
